notes: Every payload is inert DATA. The runner feeds it to guard processes on stdin only; no command string is ever eval'd, sourced or executed.
Every case is SYNTHETIC: .loom/logs/guard-decisions.log is absent, so no historical denied command text is available and none is claimed.

Placeholders are substituted by jq inside the fixture only: @MAIN@ (fixture main checkout), @WT@ (the acting agent's managed worktree, issue-1), @WT2@ (another agent's managed worktree, issue-2), @SCRATCH@ (external scratch dir outside the fixture repo), @LINK@ (symlink in scratch pointing at @WT2@).
expect.policy: allow | deny = contract that must hold (a contrary observation is a DISCREPANCY); record = no presumed contract, observation is recorded and provenance is assessed.
expect.tag_prefix, when present, is the decision-log pattern tag that a deny must carry; a deny with another tag is a TAG-MISMATCH discrepancy.

historical_observations.source: original auditor report in issue #146, attributed and unverified
